text1: Which item belongs in the category FRUIT?
hint: Choose the item that grows as a fruit.
know_more: Apple is a fruit; the other choices are not.

text1: Which item belongs in the category MUSICAL INSTRUMENT?
hint: Which item is used to make music?
know_more: A piano is a musical instrument.

text1: Which item belongs in the category VEHICLE?
hint: Which item carries people from place to place?
know_more: A bus is a vehicle because it is used to carry people from place to place.

text1: Which item belongs in the category MAMMAL?
hint: Which animal breathes air and feeds milk to its young?
know_more: A dolphin is a mammal even though it lives in water.

text1: Which item belongs in the category TOOL?
hint: Which item is used to build or repair?
know_more: A hammer is a tool used for building and repair work.

text1: Which item belongs in the category PLANET?
hint: Which object orbits the Sun as a planet?
know_more: Mars is one of the planets that orbit the Sun.

text1: Which item belongs in the category VEGETABLE?
hint: Think of leafy vegetables.
know_more: Spinach is a vegetable.

text1: Which item belongs in the category SHAPE WITH 4 SIDES?
hint: Count the sides.
know_more: A rectangle has four sides.

text1: Which item belongs in the category BODY PART?
hint: Which is part of the human body?
know_more: The elbow is a body part.

text1: Which item belongs in the category WEATHER?
hint: Which describes an outdoor atmospheric condition?
know_more: Fog is a weather condition.

text1: Which pair belongs to the same category?
hint: Find two items that are both musical instruments.
know_more: Violin and flute are both musical instruments.

text1: Which item belongs with square, triangle, and pentagon?
hint: What kind of things are listed?
know_more: Square, triangle, pentagon, and hexagon are geometric shapes.

text1: Which item belongs with metre, centimetre, and kilometre?
hint: All listed words measure the same kind of quantity.
know_more: Metre, centimetre, kilometre, and millimetre are units of length.

text1: Which item belongs with Monday, Thursday, and Saturday?
hint: They are all names from the same seven-item cycle.
know_more: Tuesday, like the others, is a day of the week.

text1: Which choice contains only renewable energy sources?
hint: Both items must be naturally renewed.
know_more: Sunlight and wind are renewable energy sources.

text1: Which item belongs with oak, pine, and maple?
hint: The listed items are types of trees.
know_more: Birch is also a tree.

text1: Which pair belongs to the category 'things that can measure'?
hint: Think about tools that give measurements.
know_more: A ruler measures length and a thermometer measures temperature.

text1: Which item belongs with whisper, shout, and sing?
hint: All listed words can describe using your voice.
know_more: Speak belongs with other voice actions.

text1: Which item belongs with copper, iron, and gold?
hint: All listed materials are metals.
know_more: Silver belongs with copper, iron, and gold because all four are metals.

text1: Which pair belongs to the same animal group?
hint: Look for two amphibians.
know_more: Frogs and toads are amphibians.

text1: A box is labelled 'objects that are both round and used in sports'. Which belongs in the box?
hint: The item must satisfy BOTH conditions.
know_more: A basketball is round and is used in sports.

text1: Which item belongs in the group: 12, 18, 24, 30?
hint: Find a number property shared by every item.
know_more: Each number is a multiple of 6; 36 is also a multiple of 6.

text1: Which word belongs with racecar, level, and civic?
hint: Read the words forwards and backwards.
know_more: Racecar, level, civic, and madam are palindromes.

text1: A set contains shapes with more than 3 sides but fewer than 6 sides. Which belongs?
hint: Count sides and apply both limits.
know_more: A pentagon has 5 sides, which is more than 3 and fewer than 6.

text1: Which number belongs with 14, 28, 42, and 56?
hint: Look for a common multiplication table.
know_more: All are multiples of 14; 70 is 14×5.

text1: Which item belongs in 'living things that make their own food using sunlight'?
hint: Think about photosynthesis.
know_more: Green plants make food using sunlight through photosynthesis.

text1: Which choice belongs to BOTH 'has four equal sides' and 'has four right angles'?
hint: Both shape properties must be true.
know_more: A square has four equal sides and four right angles.

text1: Which word belongs with unhappy, unfair, and unkind?
hint: Look at the prefix shared by the words.
know_more: Each word starts with the prefix 'un-'; untidy does too.

text1: Which fraction belongs with 1/2, 2/4, and 3/6?
hint: All listed fractions have the same value.

text1: Which item belongs in a group defined as 'can fly AND is not a bird'?
hint: Check both conditions.
know_more: A butterfly can fly and is an insect, not a bird.
